Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649942. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter where assays.chembl_id equals CHEMBL4649942, activities.standard_value is not null, and activities.standard_relation equals '='. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
